# Lyndon Farnham

Lyndon Farnham is the current Deputy of [District 1](https://flow.je/elections/district-1) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 1999.

Lyndon Farnham has participated in 5 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndon-farnham#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 unopposed.
- [**2011 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndon-farnham#e16)

  Elected as Senator with 39.3% of the ballot.
- [**2014 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndon-farnham#e19)

  Elected as Senator with 41.8% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/lyndon-farnham-2/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20151117015111/http://lyndonfarnham.je/manifesto-2/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eUqj6AeNWgs)
- [**2018 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndon-farnham#e41)

  Elected as Senator with 45.9% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/lyndon-farnham-3/)
  - [2018 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20180614162110/http://lyndonfarnham.je/manifesto-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zwQW0MNlnr8)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lkM6Ab1QuwM)
  - [2018 ITV Video](http://www.itv.com/news/channel/2018-04-10/jsy2018-lyndonfarnham/)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndon-farnham#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 1 with 29.8% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/lyndon-farnham/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lT9_A4ZtdTw)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://lyndonfarnham.je/manifesto-2022-working-to-secure-our-future/)

Lyndon Farnham has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Senators Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/02/04/chief-minister-to-stand-in-summer-election/)\]
